title: Autumn's Jacket From Julia Momosé
ldInstructionsRaw: In a shaker tin, combine the shochu, creme de cassis, Cynar, Benedictine, simple syrup, and lemon juice with ice. Shake to chill, then strain into a rocks glass over ice. Float a burning match around the tip of the rosemary sprig, to warm and awaken the herb, but not burn it. This provides woodsy aromatics without the char. Garnish with the rosemary.
